title: feat: add project management controls
body:
## Summary
Adds lightweight project management to the new history panel so users can rename saved outputs for comparison and delete stale projects/assets from local storage.

Key flow:
- `PATCH /projects/{id}` trims/validates titles and updates persisted project metadata.
- `DELETE /projects/{id}` refuses active jobs, then removes the project, related jobs/assets, and local `.local/assets/{project_id}` files.
- Recent-project cards now expose inline rename/delete controls while preserving reopen behavior.

Validation: `pytest apps/api/tests -q`, API/worker `ruff`, web lint, web typecheck, and web build all pass.

Link to Devin session: https://app.devin.ai/sessions/7f60b6b552fe4c6cb48c9867bb7c036d
Requested by: @seeincodes
